title: Involution-equivariant topological recursion and mirror symmetry for the affine binary dihedral Calabi--Yau threefold
summary: We prove a closed-string remodeling statement for the affine binary dihedral Calabi--Yau orbifold threefold $\mathcal X=[\mathbb C^2/Γ\times\mathbb C]$, where $Γ$ is a binary dihedral subgroup of $SU(2)$.
